Klasse OutputMapping<I,O>

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.automata.OutputMapping<I,O>
Typparameter:
I - the input or state type
O - the output type
public class OutputMapping<I,O> extends Object

Represents a single-input declarative output mapping for state machines (such as Moore machines).

Provides a fluent DSL entry point via from(Object) to construct mappings of the form from(state).goTo(output) and combine them into a functional mapping via combine(OutputMapping[]).

    • combine

      @SafeVarargs public static <I,O> org.quurz.foomp.base.core.Fun<I,O> combine(@NonNull OutputMapping<I,O>... mappings)

      Combines multiple OutputMapping instances into a single Fun functional mapping.

      Typparameter:
      I - the input type
      O - the output type
      Parameter:
      mappings - the mappings to combine; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a function mapping inputs to outputs based on the provided mappings
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if mappings is null or contains null elements
      IllegalStateException - if duplicate input keys are provided
